caption: The drawing depicts a single hand tool with two main components: a long, narrow, pointed iron blade and a cylindrical wooden handle. The iron blade is dark brown with patches of rust and texture detail suggesting wear and corrosion; it attaches to the handle at a right angle, forming an "L" shape. The wooden handle is light brown with visible grain, natural knots, and slightly darker shading at the ends, showing a realistic wood texture. The background is plain and off-white, providing no additional objects or scenery. A handwritten signature and date, "Octavio Moreno 1938," are present in small text on the lower right side of the image.
title: Shingle Knife
